pack.title: Mogul Money: Episode 1
pack.description: A full show adapted from the first episode of Ludwig's Mogul Money: ten board categories, a Geography category for Final Trivia (with the two tiebreakers) and the five Fast Money surveys. Questions are paraphrased. The emote category was visual on the show and is described in words here. Survey answers and numbers are illustrative, not the show's.
pack.author: Adapted from Mogul Money

clues.question: Which popular subreddit shares clips, drama and news about livestreamers?
What is the collective term for farm animals raised for meat, milk, eggs or other products?
Which American sketch-comedy show was Elon Musk hosting when the price of Dogecoin fell sharply?
clues.notes: Musk hosted on 8 May 2021.

clues.question: What is the term for filmmaking with real actors and filmed footage rather than animation?
Which 1985 charity concert raised money for famine relief in Ethiopia and drew an enormous global television audience?

categories.title: L Nerd
categories.blurb: A mixed bag for anyone who has ever been called one.

clues.question: Which anime features the detective L as the main opponent of its protagonist?
Which streetwear brand is famous for its red rectangular box logo?
What kind of baskets were originally used as basketball hoops?
What are the four major kinds of school band or ensemble?
accept: Jazz band, marching band, orchestra and concert band
clues.notes: Only jazz, marching and orchestral were clearly said on the show. "Concert" is our best guess at the fourth, so judge generously.

clues.question: Which old slang word meaning foolish or crazy has been given as the origin of the word "nerd"?
clues.notes: The show's answer. The origin of "nerd" is uncertain and this is one of several theories.

categories.title: Twitch Meta
categories.blurb: Twitch, metas and the occasional Metta.

clues.question: Which Twitch subscription benefit, introduced in 2016, became a popular way for streamers to ask viewers for a free sub?
clues.notes: Renamed Prime Gaming in 2020.

clues.question: Which NBA player went into the stands and confronted a spectator during the 2004 brawl between the Pacers and the Pistons?
clues.notes: The pun in the category: he later changed his name to Metta World Peace.

clues.question: In 2021 Twitch created a new category in response to which controversial streaming meta, involving swimwear and inflatable pools?
clues.notes: Not from the episode: it replaces a joke clue about Ludwig getting three named streamers banned. The category is "Pools, Hot Tubs, and Beaches".

clues.question: Which two hugely successful video games are both mainstays on Twitch and among the best-selling games of all time?
clues.answer: Minecraft and Grand Theft Auto V
clues.notes: Both are needed.

clues.question: What does the prefix "meta-" mean?
clues.notes: From the Greek for "after" or "beyond".

clues.question: Which sandwich chain has more locations in the United States than any other restaurant chain?
clues.notes: The show put it at more than 24,000 US locations at the time.

clues.question: What type of vessel is at the centre of the story in "The Hunt for Red October"?
Which Key & Peele sketch, set in a classroom, is one of Comedy Central's most-watched videos on YouTube?
clues.notes: The one with "A-A-ron".

clues.question: Which Pokémon move spends a quarter of the user's maximum HP to create a decoy that takes hits for it?
What word describes hidden messaging meant to influence someone without their being consciously aware of it?

categories.title: Words in Streaming
categories.blurb: Every answer can be spelled with letters from the word "streaming".

clues.question: Which digital game distribution platform did Valve launch in 2003?
What are the playable characters in Riot Games' "Valorant" called?
Which noodle dish was the first of its kind to be eaten in outer space?
clues.notes: Nissin's "Space Ram" flew on the Space Shuttle Discovery in 2005.

clues.question: Which star-shaped Pokémon has a red core at its centre that is said to send out mysterious signals?
clues.notes: Staryu has the same core but is not spelled with letters from "streaming".

clues.question: Which Greek letter became slang for a supposedly independent, lone-wolf type of man?

categories.title: Before and After
categories.blurb: Two answers that overlap, joined into one phrase.

clues.question: Combine the Pikachu-themed Game Boy game with the road Dorothy follows in "The Wizard of Oz".
Combine the free-subscription perk on Twitch with the title of Britain's head of government.
Combine the Nintendo-themed area of Universal Studios Japan with Blizzard's famous MMORPG.
Combine Riot Games' popular MOBA with the adventure game show featuring a talking stone head named Olmec.
clues.answer: League of Legends of the Hidden Temple

clues.question: Combine a slang term for a streamer who reacts to other creators' content with a British Olympic tennis champion.

categories.title: Cum in Me
categories.blurb: A word game: every answer contains the letters C-U-M in a row.

clues.question: Which Jewish religious practice traditionally involves the removal of the foreskin?
clues.notes: Brit milah is the Hebrew name, but it does not contain C-U-M. Host's call.

clues.question: What is the mathematical term for the distance around a circle?
Which verb means to give in to pressure, temptation or a stronger force?
What is the term for the person currently holding an official position, particularly in politics?
Which word means a small or limited amount of something?

categories.title: React Andy
categories.blurb: General science: chemistry, physics and reactions.

clues.question: Which chemical element has the atomic number 1?
What is often described as the fourth state of matter, alongside solids, liquids and gases?
Which kind of chemical bond commonly forms when electrons are transferred between a metal and a non-metal?
clues.notes: Not covalent: covalent bonds share electrons. The show's contestant got this one wrong.

clues.question: Which two elements are named as the essential components of organic compounds?
clues.notes: The show's wording. Strictly, a few carbon compounds counted as organic contain no hydrogen.

clues.question: How many noble gases are there in the modern periodic table?
clues.notes: Helium, neon, argon, krypton, xenon, radon and oganesson. Six is the count without oganesson.

clues.question: Which planet, the sixth from the Sun, is famous for its spectacular ring system?
In mycology, which kind of fungus can have a ring, called an annulus, around its stalk?
What was the Ring video-doorbell company called when it appeared on "Shark Tank"?
clues.notes: The sharks passed in 2013. Amazon bought Ring in 2018.

clues.question: Which Swedish pop group released a debut album called "Ring Ring"?
Which island country has a circular national highway known as the Ring Road, or Route 1?

categories.title: Who's That Pogemon
categories.blurb: Name the Twitch emote from its description.

clues.question: Which emote shows a stretched, extra-wide Pepe-style frog with a contented smile?
clues.notes: A silhouette on the show. Add the emote image in the pack editor to play it that way.

clues.question: Which emote shows Pepe the frog laughing and pointing at something?
clues.notes: A silhouette on the show. pepeLaugh is close but has no pointing; host's call.

clues.question: Which emote, its name written in capitals, shows a frog in reflective sunglasses?
clues.notes: A silhouette on the show.

clues.question: Which emote does chat spam when it wants to know whether anybody is moderating?
clues.notes: A silhouette on the show. Described here by how it is used, since the picture is hard to put into words.

clues.question: Which Canadian rapper is shown striking a pointing pose in a popular Twitch emote named after him?
clues.notes: A silhouette on the show. Nobody got it.

categories.title: Geography
categories.blurb: The show's Final Trivia category. Pick it for Final Trivia and the last clue is asked.

clues.question: Which is the largest continent by area?
clues.notes: Not from the episode: added so the category can also fill a board.

clues.question: What is the capital city of Australia?
clues.notes: Not from the episode: added so the category can also fill a board.

clues.question: Which inventor, born in Edinburgh in Scotland and closely associated with teaching the deaf, is credited with inventing the telephone?
clues.notes: The show's second tiebreaker, reworded to lead with his birthplace so it sits in this category.

clues.question: In which German city was the composer Ludwig van Beethoven born?
clues.notes: The show's first tiebreaker. Nobody got it, and the host did not reveal the answer.

clues.question: Which two countries share the longest international land border in the world?
clues.notes: The show's Final Trivia question. All three contestants first went for Russia and China.
